messages:
Ana: Hey team — draft of the launch blog for Redwood Optimize is ready for review: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xExampleLink
Ana: TL;DR: announce Optimize, show up to 2x token cost reduction on caching+batching for mid-seq workloads, call out Dedicated availability, invite to webinar. Need copy, benchmark language, legal signoff, and final publish plan. Goal: publish next Tue EOD.
Riley: Reading now. Quick thought on headline: "Cut LLM inference cost in half with Redwood Optimize" — maybe strong, can we soften to "up to 2x" or add qualifier?
Sam: Please change to "up to 2x". Add a short blurb explaining workload assumptions (median seq len, batching config).
Ana: I'll update headline to "Up to 2x lower token cost for common LLM workloads" and add a one-paragraph methodology note.
Morgan: For the benchmark paragraph I need the exact config we ran on Dedicated: model=redwood-v2-xxl, batch_target=64, KV cache enabled, context=16GB. Run summary below.
Morgan: run summary: median input=256 tokens, avg output=64 tokens, microbatching=8, host offload disabled, quant=fp16. Cost normalized per 1M tokens.
Sam: Perfect. Add an appendix link to the benchmark notebook and CSV. Repro need.
Lee: Any competitor comparisons need legal-approved phrasing. Use neutral language: "in our tests" and include methodology. CC: legal.
Ana: Lee can you do a quick read tomorrow?
Lee: Sure. I'll review for comparative claims and privacy blurb for lead capture.
Max: On leads/webinar routing — use utm_source=blog, utm_medium=launch, utm_campaign=optimize_may2026. Form param source=blog_optimize to map to SFDC. Add hidden field benchmark_variant for A/B CTA.
Ana: Thanks. Also, do we want a gated benchmark report for qualified leads?
Max: Yes — gated benchmark notebook in exchange for email; route to MQL flow; auto-tag benchmark_download.
Riley: Copy note: open with an anonymized customer snippet, then benchmark highlights, then how-to section.
Sam: Add a short "How to get started" with a small API example.
Riley: Proposed snippet: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-optimize-1","prompt":"Summarize...","max_tokens":64}'
```
Riley: I'll add that.
Morgan: Infra needs to wire publish hook to emit blog_publish webhook including UTM params. I can add the hook but need exact field names.
Max: Field names: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, gclid (optional), campaign_id, lead_flow=benchmark_download.
Morgan: Got it. I'll add mapping to webhook payload and attach to CMS publish.
Ana: Who can run final proof and publishing checklist on Monday? I can do copy but need a second pair.
Riley: I can do grammar pass Monday AM.
Lee: Legal review by Monday EOD.
Sam: Product review approved pending final benchmark appendix link.
Max: Growth signoff: UTM and MQL routing good. Webinar listing created in HubSpot. Webinar signup form URL: https://app.hubspot.com/forms/12345/optimize-webinar
Ana: Aiming to publish Tue 10:00 PDT. Webinar promo email scheduled for Wed.
Morgan: Webhook in place; will attach publish script so payload is sent on publish.
deploy-bot: Scheduled publish job created: blog/optimize -> 2026-05-12T10:00:00-07:00. Status: scheduled.
Ana: Confirming final publish date: May 12 at 10am PDT works.
Riley: Confirmed from copy side.
Lee: Legal ok with May 12.
Max: Moving webinar to May 19 to be after publish; updated HubSpot.
Sam: Final action items: Ana update doc with methodology & appendix links; Morgan confirm webhook/publish; Lee legal signoff; Riley proof; Max/growth make gated asset + UTMs.
Ana: I'll update doc tonight and ping when ready for final read.
Riley: :thumbsup:
Max: :rocket:
Lee: :white_check_mark:
Morgan: Will post the publish payload example in the doc once wired.
